product_summary: Get Path is an AI-powered career and learning-pathway web app that turns a person's current skills and target role into a personalized, step-by-step skill roadmap. It serves early-career professionals and career-changers who know where they want to go but not how to get there.

goals.title: Personalized roadmaps
goals.detail: Let any user go from a target role to a concrete, ordered skill roadmap in under five minutes.

goals.title: Trustworthy AI recommendations
goals.detail: Generate roadmap steps grounded in a curated skills graph so suggestions feel credible rather than generic.

goals.title: Visible progress
goals.detail: Give users a clear way to track which roadmap milestones they have completed and what comes next.

goals.title: Validated v1 launch
goals.detail: Ship a lean, production-deployed MVP that real users can sign up for and complete an end-to-end roadmap flow.

deliverables.name: Foundation & Project Setup
deliverables.description: Stand up the application skeleton, repository, environments, and CI so all later work lands on a stable, deployable base.

tasks.name: Scaffold Next.js app, repo, linting, and folder conventions
Provision Postgres + hosting and wire staging/production environments
Set up CI pipeline, env-var management, and preview deploys

deliverables.name: Authentication & User Profiles
deliverables.description: Email-based account creation and a profile that captures the user's current skills and target role, which feed the recommendation engine.

tasks.name: Implement email/password auth with sessions and password reset
Build profile data model (current skills, target role, experience level)
Create profile onboarding UI and skill/role input flow

deliverables.name: Skills Graph & Roadmap Data Model
deliverables.description: The curated skills/role knowledge graph and roadmap schema that the AI grounds its recommendations against, plus seed content for launch.

tasks.name: Design skills/roles graph schema and roadmap/milestone tables
Seed curated skills graph for 3 launch career tracks
Build roadmap CRUD + persistence and milestone status tracking

deliverables.name: AI Roadmap Recommendation Engine
deliverables.description: The core differentiator: an LLM/agent integration that reads the user's profile and the skills graph to assemble a personalized, ordered roadmap.

tasks.name: Define prompt + retrieval flow that grounds the LLM in the skills graph
Implement agent orchestration to assemble and order roadmap steps
Add output validation, guardrails, and graceful fallbacks
Tune ranking and add caching to control latency and token cost

deliverables.name: Roadmap UI & Progress Experience
deliverables.description: The interactive roadmap view where users explore their generated path, mark milestones complete, and regenerate or refine their roadmap.

tasks.name: Build interactive roadmap visualization with milestone detail panels
Implement progress tracking, completion state, and dashboard
Add roadmap regeneration/refine flow and responsive polish

deliverables.name: Testing, Launch & Handoff
deliverables.description: End-to-end validation of the core flow, production deployment, and a clean handoff so the client can operate and extend Get Path.

tasks.name: End-to-end validation of signup-to-roadmap flow on staging
Production deploy, monitoring, and analytics instrumentation
Handoff: docs, runbook, and walkthrough session

assumptions: Client provides brand assets (logo, colors, fonts) and approved copy for the three launch career tracks.
Scope is a single responsive web platform; no native mobile app.
Client supplies or approves an LLM provider API key and accepts usage-based AI costs.
A single English-language locale is sufficient for v1.
Subject-matter input for the curated skills graph is available from the client or a designated expert.
One staging and one production environment are sufficient for launch.
constraints: Recommendations are limited to the three seeded career tracks at launch.
Email/password authentication only; no third-party SSO in this build.
AI roadmap generation is grounded in the curated skills graph rather than open-ended web browsing.
Fixed five-week timeline aligned to the five delivery phases.
out_of_scope: Single sign-on (Google/GitHub/SAML) and enterprise identity integration.
Integrations with external course catalogs or job boards.
Admin CMS for non-technical editing of the skills graph.
